_meta.title: James — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 5 chapters of James. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 59 James); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-5, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
verses.plain: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds,

verses.text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.plain: If any of you lacks wisdom, ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

verses.text: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verses.plain: Blessed is the one who perseveres under trial, because having stood the test, they will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love him.

verses.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.plain: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

verses.text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.plain: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.

verses.text: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
verses.plain: In the same way, faith by itself, if it isn't accompanied by action, is dead.

verses.text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.plain: But the wisdom that comes from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.

verses.text: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.plain: So submit yourselves to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

verses.text: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
verses.plain: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

verses.text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
verses.plain: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

verses.text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.plain: So confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The earnest prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.
